sections.content: How many people are "roundspersons and van salespersons"?

6,260 people

were counted on the census as "roundspersons and van salespersons" in England and Wales in March 2021.

Roundspersons and van salespersons deliver and sell food, drink and other goods by calling on householders or by selling from a mobile shop or van, and call on households to collect and receive payment for laundered or similarly serviced articles.

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "roundspersons and van salespersons" there were more men than women (87.8% compared with 12.2%).

This means "roundspersons and van salespersons" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "sales occupations".

Men made up 87.8% and women made up 12.2% of "roundspersons and van salespersons"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "roundspersons and van salespersons" included:

  • paper and wood machine operatives
  • production managers and directors in construction
  • garage managers and proprietors

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

People who had this job were generally older

The occupation of "roundspersons and van salespersons" had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 55 to 59 years. Of the whole working population 10.4% were aged 55 to 59 years. For people working as "roundspersons and van salespersons", 15.6% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "roundspersons and van salespersons" was 16 to 19 years.

Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "roundspersons and van salespersons" included:

  • market and street traders and assistants
  • library clerks and assistants
  • gardeners and landscape gardeners

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

We can look at who worked as "roundspersons and van salespersons" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Among those aged under 30 years old, we see there is a higher proportion of women with this occupation than men.

The percentage of men and women who are "roundspersons and van salespersons" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "roundspersons and van salespersons", 10.4% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (67.2% compared with 32.8%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (55.5%) than self-employed (44.5%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the North West. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Bradford, this is in the region of the Yorkshire & Humberside.
